description:
FILED by the reviewing session at s543m's merge (MAIN-READY-113 caf9c693, 2026-11-27).  The drop flush of #5354 / #5405 (a filehandle held only by a container that is cleared, shrunk or overwritten with undef is written out, as perl closes it) tests the OLD contents at every statement that statically drops them.

MEASURED (s543m's timing legs, scratch/s543m/legs/R2-bench-a.log and R2-bench-b.log in its worktree agent-ac39a725d1d338842; base 9a3ce86f -> tree 5d426786, an idle box, exclusive legs):
  `@a = ()` of 20 elements     +80.9 %  (+0.14 us a clear)
  `%h = ()` of 20 keys          +11.8 %  (+0.12 us a clear)
  `$h{k} = undef`, plain lexical +35.7 %  (+10 ns a store); an `our` holder +44.8 %; a sub-captured `my` +47.3 % (+11 ns)
  a store and a pop under an `if` modifier +17.2 % (+9 ns an iteration)
  IN NOISE: the sub-tail delete (-0.6 %), void pop / shift (-1.2 %), a sub returning a lexical (-2.9 %).

WHY IT COSTS: the clear walks the old contents (`%p-may-hold-handle-p`, bounded by `+p-flush-walk-limit+`) before the store; the element store peeks the old slot.

DIRECTIONS, none designed: (a) a process-wide 'a lexical filehandle has ever been stored into an aggregate' flag that the open / store path sets, so the test is ONE special read while no program has done so (most never do); (b) the walk only when the container's FIRST element is a reference or a handle (a typed fast exit); (c) nothing -- 0.14 us a clear may be acceptable.

THE CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (not taken): `tools/board-timing.pl --run` and the bench suite's median before / after s543m -- if no row of real programs moves outside noise, close this as (c).

BAR: the flagged rows back inside the noise band of docs/caller-implementation.md 'What it costs' with rm / rm2 / rm3 (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/probes-1127) unchanged.
subject: PERF (flagged cost of s543m's drop flush): `@a = ()` +81 %, `%h = ()` +12 %, `$h{k} = undef` +36..47 %, a store or pop under a modifier +17 % -- the may-hold-a-handle test runs at every clear / undef store
